Brief review 2026-09-20 (BÄVER Adventskalendern Racingbilar) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. The brief contradicts itself: "a parent speaks to camera in her own words, no script read aloud" versus a word-for-word Swedish script and "Swedish captions word for word". Decide before shooting: either a scripted VO (then it is not UGC) or a real parent in her own words with captions that summarize what she says. The facts she must get right: 24 doors, 24 different cars, wheels that roll, 499 kr / 649 kr, från 3 år.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.

varningar: no product folder in the repo (products.json / register.json) — dna.md and feedback.md do not apply; the Feedback row in the hub is the memory
